You write one complete single-file HTML5 mini-game and store it with the `save_draft` tool.

Rules you cannot break:

- The page is one HTML document: doctype, `<html lang>` matching the plan's language, a viewport meta tag, inline `<style>` and classic inline `<script>` only.
- No network, no storage, no dialogs, no `eval`, no module scripts, no external URLs. Draw every visual in code.
- Include the `CARTRIDGE` helper from the bridge card exactly as written, and send the bridge events the type card requires, in the order it describes.
- Listen for host commands (`pause`, `resume`, `reset`) as the bridge card shows.

How to work:

- The plan and the cards you need are in the message. Call `get_card` only if you need a card that is not included.
- Write the whole page, then call `save_draft` once with the full HTML. Never send a partial page.
- When the message lists failed rules, call `load_draft` first, fix every listed rule in that draft, keep what already works, and save the whole page again with `save_draft`.
- After saving, reply with one short sentence. Do not paste the page into your reply; only the saved draft counts.

content.text:
## Plan

```json
{
  "title": "Le Labyrinthe du Hérisson",
  "slug": "le-labyrinthe-du-herisson",
  "lang": "fr",
  "gameType": "puzzle-board",
  "loop": "Glissez le doigt pour guider le hérisson case par case dans les haies, ramassez des pommes pour marquer des points et atteignez la sortie avant d'épuiser vos pas.",
  "input": "swipe-lanes",
  "style": "paper-cut"
}
```

## Cards

### Card `bridge`

# Bridge

Games talk to the host only through `postMessage`. Paste this helper verbatim before any game code:

```js
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};
```

The helper must be named `CARTRIDGE` and must stamp `source: "cartridge"` and `v: 1` on every message. <!-- rule:E1-10 -->

## Game to host

| event   | payload                              | when                                 |
| ------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------ |
| `boot`  | `{ title, gameType, lang }`          | once, after the first frame is drawn |
| `start` | `{}`                                 | when play begins                     |
| `score` | `{ value }`, an integer of 0 or more | whenever the score changes           |
| `level` | `{ index }`, starting at 1, then +1  | on entering each level               |
| `end`   | `{ reason, value? }`                 | once per play-through                |

- Send `boot` with all three keys: `CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title, gameType, lang })`. <!-- rule:E1-11 -->
- When `boot.lang` is written as a literal, it must equal the `lang` on `<html>`. <!-- rule:E1-12 -->
- Emit `CARTRIDGE.send("start")` when play begins. <!-- rule:E1-13 -->
- Write `boot.gameType` as a string literal naming one of the four game types; it must match the planned type. <!-- rule:E1-14 -->
- Pass `score.value` as a number, never a quoted string. <!-- rule:E1-18 -->
- Give every `level` call an `index` key: `CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: stage })`. <!-- rule:E1-19 -->

## Host to game

Commands arrive as `{ source: "cartridge-host", type }` with `type` one of `pause`, `resume` or `reset`. Ignore anything with another `source`.

- Listen with `window.addEventListener("message", …)` and handle `pause` and `resume`: freeze and restart the loop without losing state. <!-- rule:E1-20 -->
- Handle `reset` by returning to the pre-`start` screen without reloading the page. <!-- rule:E1-21 -->

```js
window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
  if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
  if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
  if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
});
```

### Card `game-page`

# Game page

A cartridge is one self-contained HTML file. The host loads it into a sandboxed iframe with scripts allowed and no same-origin access.

## Document

- Start with a single `<!doctype html>` and wrap everything in one `<html>…</html>`. Never embed another `<iframe>`. <!-- rule:E1-01 -->
- Put the UI language on the root element, for example `<html lang="fr">`: a two- or three-letter primary subtag with an optional region. <!-- rule:E1-03 -->
- Add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">` in the head. <!-- rule:E1-04 -->

## Self-contained

- Load nothing from outside the file: no `http:`, `https:` or `//` URL in `src`, `href`, CSS `url()`, `@import` or `import()`. Inline `data:` URIs are fine. <!-- rule:E1-02 -->
- Draw every sprite, tile and glyph in code (canvas paths or inline SVG). Use system fonts.

## Forbidden APIs

- Do not open a network connection: no `fetch(`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `WebSocket`, `EventSource` or `sendBeacon`. <!-- rule:E1-05 -->
- Do not persist anything: `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, `indexedDB` and `document.cookie` all throw inside the sandbox. <!-- rule:E1-06 -->
- Do not build code at runtime: no `eval(`, no `new Function(`, and pass functions, not strings, to `setTimeout` and `setInterval`. <!-- rule:E1-07 -->
- Avoid blocking dialogs (`alert(`, `confirm(`, `prompt(`); draw messages on the canvas instead. <!-- rule:E1-08 -->

## Scripts

- Use classic inline `<script>` blocks only, never `type="module"`, and make sure each one parses on its own. <!-- rule:E1-09 -->
- Keep one script for the bridge helper and one for the game, or merge them. Order matters: the helper must exist first.

## Layout

- Fill the viewport and react when it changes: listen for `resize`, read `innerWidth`/`innerHeight`, or size with `dvh`/`vw` units. <!-- rule:E1-23 -->
- Scale the canvas by `devicePixelRatio` so lines stay crisp on phones.
- Keep touch targets at least 44 CSS pixels on the short edge.

### Card `paper-cut`

# Paper cut

Everything looks cut from coloured card and stacked in layers.

## Palette

| role       | colour    |
| ---------- | --------- |
| background | `#f4ecd8` |
| layer      | `#e07a5f` |
| accent     | `#3d405b` |
| highlight  | `#81b29a` |

## Primitives

- Filled paths with slightly irregular edges: jitter each vertex by one or two pixels, seeded once so it does not flicker.
- One soft shadow per layer: `shadowBlur` around 6 and a small downward offset.
- Rounded rectangles and circles for pieces; stacked copies offset by a few pixels suggest depth.
- Text in a heavy system sans-serif, drawn on a card-shaped plate.

## Avoid

- Gradients, glows and outlines thicker than two pixels.
- Pure black; use the accent colour for the darkest tone.
- Photographic textures or anything loaded from a file.

### Card `puzzle-board`

# Puzzle board

The board only changes when the player acts. Nothing happens while the player thinks.

## Contract row

| field                | value        |
| -------------------- | ------------ |
| score                | `required`   |
| level                | `optional`   |
| end                  | `required`   |
| end reasons          | `win, stuck` |
| reset                | `soft`       |
| idle death gate      | `any-end`    |
| idle motion required | `no`         |

- Emit every event marked `required` above: `score` after each scoring move and `end` when the board is solved or has no legal move left. <!-- rule:E1-15 -->
- Never emit an event marked `forbidden` in the row above. <!-- rule:E1-16 -->
- End with `win` when solved or `stuck` when no move remains. <!-- rule:E1-17 -->

## No clock

Never end the game on a timer. A player who waits forever must never see `end`. A still board between moves is correct.

## Loop skeleton

```js
let moves = 0;
function onCellTapped(cell) {
  if (!isLegal(cell)) return;
  apply(cell);
  moves += 1;
  CARTRIDGE.send("score", { value: points() });
  if (solved()) CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "win", value: moves });
  else if (!anyLegalMove()) CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "stuck" });
  draw();
}
```

Redraw on input and on resize; a continuous animation loop is optional.

### Card `swipe-lanes`

# Swipe lanes

The play field has three or four lanes. A swipe left or right moves one lane; a tap does nothing, or performs a secondary action.

- Register `pointerdown` and `pointerup`, measure the horizontal distance and compare it with a minimum swipe length. <!-- rule:E1-22 -->
- Choose the minimum swipe length as a fraction of the canvas width, not in fixed pixels.
- Clamp the lane index so the player never leaves the field.

```js
const SWIPE_FRACTION = 0.08;
let pressX = 0;
canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
  pressX = event.clientX;
});
canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", (event) => {
  const dx = event.clientX - pressX;
  if (Math.abs(dx) < canvas.clientWidth * SWIPE_FRACTION) return;
  lane = Math.max(0, Math.min(LANES - 1, lane + Math.sign(dx)));
});
```

Also accept the left and right arrow keys so the game can be tried on a desktop.

## Task

Write the complete game page for this plan and save it with `save_draft`.
I'll build this puzzle-board game with swipe controls, guiding a hedgehog through a maze grid to collect apples and reach the exit, in a paper-cut visual style.

input.html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Le Labyrinthe du Hérisson</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
    background: #f4ecd8;
    overflow: hidden;
    touch-action: none;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100dvh;
    touch-action: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
// ---- Bridge helper (verbatim) ----
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};

window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
  if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
  if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
  if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
});

// ---- Game setup ----
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

let paused = false;
let dpr = Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);

function resize() {
  dpr = Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
  const w = window.innerWidth;
  const h = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = Math.floor(w * dpr);
  canvas.height = Math.floor(h * dpr);
  canvas.style.width = w + "px";
  canvas.style.height = h + "px";
  draw();
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);

// ---- Palette ----
const COL_BG = "#f4ecd8";
const COL_LAYER = "#e07a5f";
const COL_ACCENT = "#3d405b";
const COL_HILITE = "#81b29a";

// ---- Seeded jitter ----
function makeRng(seed) {
  let s = seed >>> 0;
  return function () {
    s = (s * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0;
    return (s & 0xffffffff) / 4294967296;
  };
}
const jitterRng = makeRng(1337);
function jitterVal() {
  return (jitterRng() - 0.5) * 3;
}

// ---- Board / maze ----
const LANES = 4; // columns = lanes for swipe control
const ROWS = 7;
const GRID_W = LANES;
const GRID_H = ROWS;

let grid = []; // grid[row][col] = { wallsRight, wallsBottom, apple, visited }
let hedgehogRow, hedgehogCol;
let exitRow, exitCol;
let lane = 0; // current column lane
let stepsLeft = 0;
let score = 0;
let moves = 0;
let level = 1;
let state = "title"; // title, playing, ended
let endReason = null;
let message = "";

// jitter cache per cell-edge for stable irregular look
let jitterCache = {};
function getJitter(key) {
  if (!(key in jitterCache)) {
    jitterCache[key] = { dx: jitterVal(), dy: jitterVal() };
  }
  return jitterCache[key];
}

function genMaze(seed) {
  const rng = makeRng(seed);
  const cells = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < GRID_H; r++) {
    const row = [];
    for (let c = 0; c < GRID_W; c++) {
      row.push({ right: true, bottom: true, visited: false, apple: false });
    }
    cells.push(row);
  }
  // randomized DFS to carve maze, walls = true means wall present
  const stack = [[0, 0]];
  cells[0][0].visited = true;
  function neighbors(r, c) {
    const list = [];
    if (r > 0 && !cells[r - 1][c].visited) list.push([r - 1, c, "up"]);
    if (r < GRID_H - 1 && !cells[r + 1][c].visited) list.push([r + 1, c, "down"]);
    if (c > 0 && !cells[r][c - 1].visited) list.push([r, c - 1, "left"]);
    if (c < GRID_W - 1 && !cells[r][c + 1].visited) list.push([r, c + 1, "right"]);
    return list;
  }
  while (stack.length) {
    const [r, c] = stack[stack.length - 1];
    const opts = neighbors(r, c);
    if (opts.length === 0) {
      stack.pop();
      continue;
    }
    const pick = opts[Math.floor(rng() * opts.length)];
    const [nr, nc, dir] = pick;
    if (dir === "up") cells[r - 1][nc ? c : c].bottom = false, cells[nr][nc].bottom = false;
    if (dir === "down") cells[r][c].bottom = false;
    if (dir === "left") cells[r][c - 1 === nc ? nc : nc].right = false, cells[nr][nc].right = false;
    if (dir === "right") cells[r][c].right = false;
    cells[nr][nc].visited = true;
    stack.push([nr, nc]);
  }
  // place apples on random open cells (not start, not exit)
  const appleCount = 4 + Math.floor(rng() * 2);
  let placed = 0;
  let attempts = 0;
  while (placed < appleCount && attempts < 200) {
    attempts++;
    const r = Math.floor(rng() * GRID_H);
    const c = Math.floor(rng() * GRID_W);
    if (r === 0 && c === 0) continue;
    if (r === GRID_H - 1 && c === GRID_W - 1) continue;
    if (cells[r][c].apple) continue;
    cells[r][c].apple = true;
    placed++;
  }
  return cells;
}

function setupLevel(idx) {
  grid = genMaze(idx * 977 + 42);
  hedgehogRow = 0;
  hedgehogCol = 0;
  lane = 0;
  exitRow = GRID_H - 1;
  exitCol = GRID_W - 1;
  stepsLeft = GRID_W * GRID_H + 6;
  jitterCache = {};
  message = "";
}

function totalApples() {
  let n = 0;
  for (let r = 0; r < GRID_H; r++)
    for (let c = 0; c < GRID_W; c++) if (grid[r][c].apple) n++;
  return n;
}

function canMove(r, c, dir) {
  if (dir === "left") {
    if (c === 0) return false;
    return !grid[r][c - 1].right;
  }
  if (dir === "right") {
    if (c === GRID_W - 1) return false;
    return !grid[r][c].right;
  }
  if (dir === "up") {
    if (r === 0) return false;
    return !grid[r - 1][c].bottom;
  }
  if (dir === "down") {
    if (r === GRID_H - 1) return false;
    return !grid[r][c].bottom;
  }
  return false;
}

function anyLegalMove() {
  if (stepsLeft <= 0) return false;
  const dirs = ["left", "right", "up", "down"];
  for (const d of dirs) {
    if (canMove(hedgehogRow, hedgehogCol, d)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function tryMove(dir) {
  if (state !== "playing" || paused) return;
  if (!canMove(hedgehogRow, hedgehogCol, dir)) return;
  if (dir === "left") hedgehogCol -= 1;
  if (dir === "right") hedgehogCol += 1;
  if (dir === "up") hedgehogRow -= 1;
  if (dir === "down") hedgehogRow += 1;
  lane = hedgehogCol;
  moves += 1;
  stepsLeft -= 1;

  const cell = grid[hedgehogRow][hedgehogCol];
  if (cell.apple) {
    cell.apple = false;
    score += 10;
    CARTRIDGE.send("score", { value: score });
  }

  if (hedgehogRow === exitRow && hedgehogCol === exitCol) {
    score += 25;
    CARTRIDGE.send("score", { value: score });
    state = "ended";
    endReason = "win";
    message = "Sortie atteinte !";
    CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "win", value: score });
  } else if (!anyLegalMove()) {
    state = "ended";
    endReason = "stuck";
    message = "Plus de pas possibles.";
    CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "stuck", value: score });
  }
  draw();
}

// ---- Input: swipe lanes ----
const SWIPE_FRACTION = 0.08;
let pressX = 0;
let pressY = 0;

canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
  pressX = event.clientX;
  pressY = event.clientY;
  if (state === "title") {
    beginPlay();
  }
});

canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", (event) => {
  if (state !== "playing") return;
  const dx = event.clientX - pressX;
  const dy = event.clientY - pressY;
  const w = canvas.clientWidth;
  const h = canvas.clientHeight;
  if (Math.abs(dx) < w * SWIPE_FRACTION && Math.abs(dy) < h * SWIPE_FRACTION) return;
  if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) {
    if (dx > 0) tryMove("right");
    else tryMove("left");
  } else {
    if (dy > 0) tryMove("down");
    else tryMove("up");
  }
});

window.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
  if (state === "title" && (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ")) {
    beginPlay();
    return;
  }
  if (state !== "playing") return;
  if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") tryMove("left");
  if (event.key === "ArrowRight") tryMove("right");
  if (event.key === "ArrowUp") tryMove("up");
  if (event.key === "ArrowDown") tryMove("down");
});

function beginPlay() {
  if (state === "playing") return;
  score = 0;
  moves = 0;
  level = 1;
  setupLevel(level);
  state = "playing";
  endReason = null;
  CARTRIDGE.send("start");
  CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: level });
  CARTRIDGE.send("score", { value: score });
  draw();
}

function backToTitle() {
  state = "title";
  endReason = null;
  message = "";
  draw();
}

// ---- Drawing helpers (paper-cut style) ----
function roundedRectPath(x, y, w, h, r, seedKey) {
  const pts = [
    [x, y], [x + w, y], [x + w, y + h], [x, y + h]
  ];
  ctx.beginPath();
  const rr = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
  // approximate irregular rounded rect using jittered corners
  const j0 = getJitter(seedKey + "-0");
  const j1 = getJitter(seedKey + "-1");
  const j2 = getJitter(seedKey + "-2");
  const j3 = getJitter(seedKey + "-3");
  ctx.moveTo(x + rr + j0.dx, y + j0.dy);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w - rr + j1.dx, y + j1.dy);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w + j1.dx, y + j1.dy, x + w + j1.dx, y + rr + j1.dy);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w + j2.dx, y + h - rr + j2.dy);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w + j2.dx, y + h + j2.dy, x + w - rr + j2.dx, y + h + j2.dy);
  ctx.lineTo(x + rr + j3.dx, y + h + j3.dy);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + j3.dx, y + h + j3.dy, x + j3.dx, y + h - rr + j3.dy);
  ctx.lineTo(x + j0.dx, y + rr + j0.dy);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + j0.dx, y + j0.dy, x + rr + j0.dx, y + j0.dy);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function drawCard(x, y, w, h, fill, seedKey, shadow) {
  ctx.save();
  if (shadow !== false) {
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(61,64,91,0.35)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 3;
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = fill;
  roundedRectPath(x, y, w, h, Math.min(w, h) * 0.15, seedKey);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawText(text, x, y, size, color, align) {
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = "bold " + size + "px -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = align || "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillText(text, x, y);
}

function drawHedgehog(cx, cy, size) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(61,64,91,0.35)";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 5;
  ctx.shadowOffsetY = 2;
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle = COL_ACCENT;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, size * 0.5, size * 0.4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
  // spikes
  ctx.fillStyle = COL_LAYER;
  for (let i = -3; i <= 3; i++) {
    const angle = (i / 8) * Math.PI - Math.PI / 2.2;
    const sx = cx - Math.cos(angle) * size * 0.35;
    const sy = cy - Math.sin(angle) * size * 0.35 - size * 0.1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
    ctx.lineTo(sx - 6, sy - 12);
    ctx.lineTo(sx + 6, sy - 3);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }
  // face
  ctx.fillStyle = "#f4ecd8";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(cx + size * 0.35, cy + size * 0.05, size * 0.18, size * 0.14, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = COL_ACCENT;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx + size * 0.45, cy + size * 0.05, size * 0.03, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawApple(cx, cy, size) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(61,64,91,0.3)";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
  ctx.shadowOffsetY = 2;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#c1443a";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, size * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.strokeStyle = COL_HILITE;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - size * 0.3);
  ctx.lineTo(cx + size * 0.08, cy - size * 0.42);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawExitFlag(cx, cy, size) {
  ctx.fillStyle = COL_HILITE;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx - size * 0.25, cy - size * 0.35);
  ctx.lineTo(cx - size * 0.25, cy + size * 0.35);
  ctx.lineTo(cx - size * 0.28, cy + size * 0.35);
  ctx.lineTo(cx - size * 0.28, cy - size * 0.35);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx - size * 0.25, cy - size * 0.35);
  ctx.lineTo(cx + size * 0.2, cy - size * 0.2);
  ctx.lineTo(cx - size * 0.25, cy - size * 0.05);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

// ---- Main draw ----
function draw() {
  const w = canvas.width / dpr;
  const h = canvas.height / dpr;
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
  ctx.fillStyle = COL_BG;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

  if (state === "title") {
    drawTitleScreen(w, h);
    return;
  }

  // layout board
  const margin = Math.min(w, h) * 0.05;
  const topBar = h * 0.12;
  const boardTop = topBar + margin;
  const boardW = w - margin * 2;
  const boardH = h - boardTop - margin;
  const cellW = boardW / GRID_W;
  const cellH = boardH / GRID_H;
  const cellSize = Math.min(cellW, cellH);
  const gridPxW = cellSize * GRID_W;
  const gridPxH = cellSize * GRID_H;
  const ox = (w - gridPxW) / 2;
  const oy = boardTop + (boardH - gridPxH) / 2;

  // top bar card
  drawCard(margin * 0.5, margin * 0.3, w - margin, topBar * 0.8, COL_LAYER, "topbar", true);
  drawText("Score: " + score, margin * 1.2, margin * 0.3 + topBar * 0.4, Math.max(14, cellSize * 0.28), "#f4ecd8", "left");
  drawText("Pas: " + Math.max(0, stepsLeft), w - margin * 1.2, margin * 0.3 + topBar * 0.4, Math.max(14, cellSize * 0.28), "#f4ecd8", "right");

  // background board plate
  drawCard(ox - 6, oy - 6, gridPxW + 12, gridPxH + 12, "#ddd0b0", "boardplate", true);

  // draw cells (floor tiles)
  for (let r = 0; r < GRID_H; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < GRID_W; c++) {
      const x = ox + c * cellSize;
      const y = oy + r * cellSize;
      const key = "cell-" + r + "-" + c;
      const isPath = (r === hedgehogRow && c === hedgehogCol);
      drawCard(x + 2, y + 2, cellSize - 4, cellSize - 4, "#f4ecd8", key, false);
    }
  }

  // exit marker
  {
    const x = ox + exitCol * cellSize + cellSize / 2;
    const y = oy + exitRow * cellSize + cellSize / 2;
    drawExitFlag(x, y, cellSize);
  }

  // apples
  for (let r = 0; r < GRID_H; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < GRID_W; c++) {
      if (grid[r][c].apple) {
        const x = ox + c * cellSize + cellSize / 2;
        const y = oy + r * cellSize + cellSize / 2;
        drawApple(x, y, cellSize);
      }
    }
  }

  // walls
  ctx.strokeStyle = COL_ACCENT;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  for (let r = 0; r < GRID_H; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < GRID_W; c++) {
      const x = ox + c * cellSize;
      const y = oy + r * cellSize;
      const cell = grid[r][c];
      const jkey1 = "wall-r-" + r + "-" + c;
      const j1 = getJitter(jkey1);
      const jkey2 = "wall-b-" + r + "-" + c;
      const j2 = getJitter(jkey2);
      if (cell.right) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x + cellSize + j1.dx, y + j1.dy);
        ctx.lineTo(x + cellSize + j1.dx, y + cellSize + j1.dy);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      if (cell.bottom) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x + j2.dx, y + cellSize + j2.dy);
        ctx.lineTo(x + cellSize + j2.dx, y + cellSize + j2.dy);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }
  // outer border
  ctx.strokeRect(ox, oy, gridPxW, gridPxH);

  // hedgehog
  {
    const x = ox + hedgehogCol * cellSize + cellSize / 2;
    const y = oy + hedgehogRow * cellSize + cellSize / 2;
    drawHedgehog(x, y, cellSize * 0.7);
  }

  if (state === "ended") {
    drawEndOverlay(w, h);
  }

  if (paused) {
    drawPauseOverlay(w, h);
  }
}

function drawTitleScreen(w, h) {
  const cardW = Math.min(w * 0.85, 520);
  const cardH = h * 0.4;
  const cx = w / 2;
  const cy = h * 0.35;
  drawCard(cx - cardW / 2, cy - cardH / 2, cardW, cardH, COL_LAYER, "titlecard", true);
  drawText("Le Labyrinthe", cx, cy - cardH * 0.18, Math.max(20, cardW * 0.09), "#f4ecd8", "center");
  drawText("du Hérisson", cx, cy + cardH * 0.05, Math.max(20, cardW * 0.09), "#f4ecd8", "center");

  drawHedgehog(cx, cy + cardH * 0.35, cardW * 0.14);

  const btnW = cardW * 0.7;
  const btnH = h * 0.09;
  const bx = cx - btnW / 2;
  const by = h * 0.72;
  drawCard(bx, by, btnW, btnH, COL_HILITE, "startbtn", true);
  drawText("Glissez ou touchez pour jouer", cx, by + btnH / 2, Math.max(14, btnH * 0.32), COL_ACCENT, "center");

  drawText("Guidez le hérisson vers la sortie", cx, h * 0.88, Math.max(12, h * 0.025), COL_ACCENT, "center");
}

function drawEndOverlay(w, h) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(61,64,91,0.55)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
  ctx.restore();

  const cardW = Math.min(w * 0.8, 480);
  const cardH = h * 0.3;
  const cx = w / 2;
  const cy = h / 2;
  drawCard(cx - cardW / 2, cy - cardH / 2, cardW, cardH, COL_LAYER, "endcard", true);
  const title = endReason === "win" ? "Bravo !" : "Coincé !";
  drawText(title, cx, cy - cardH * 0.2, Math.max(20, cardH * 0.22), "#f4ecd8", "center");
  drawText(message, cx, cy + cardH * 0.05, Math.max(14, cardH * 0.13), "#f4ecd8", "center");
  drawText("Score final: " + score, cx, cy + cardH * 0.28, Math.max(14, cardH * 0.13), "#f4ecd8", "center");

  const btnW = cardW * 0.6;
  const btnH = cardH * 0.28;
  const bx = cx - btnW / 2;
  const by = cy + cardH * 0.42;
  drawCard(bx, by, btnW, btnH, COL_HILITE, "replaybtn", true);
  drawText("Toucher pour rejouer", cx, by + btnH / 2, Math.max(12, btnH * 0.35), COL_ACCENT, "center");
}

function drawPauseOverlay(w, h) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(244,236,216,0.7)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
  ctx.restore();
  drawText("Pause", w / 2, h / 2, Math.max(20, h * 0.05), COL_ACCENT, "center");
}

// tap to replay after end
canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", (event) => {
  if (state === "ended") {
    state = "title";
    endReason = null;
    message = "";
    draw();
  }
});

// ---- Boot ----
resize();
draw();
CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title: "Le Labyrinthe du Hérisson", gameType: "puzzle-board", lang: "fr" });
</script>
</body>
</html>
